meta.name: add-whatsapp
meta.description: Add WhatsApp channel via native Baileys adapter. Direct connection — no Chat SDK bridge. Uses QR code or pairing code for authentication.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接入 WhatsApp 渠道,直接收发消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发需要与 WhatsApp 收发消息的应用或机器人.
copy.tagline_en: Connect WhatsApp channel for direct messaging
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app or bot that needs to send and receive WhatsApp messages.

howto.what: 它给项目加上 WhatsApp 频道：从 channels 分支复制 Baileys 原生适配器和 whatsapp-formatting 技能，注册适配器、按固定版本安装依赖、构建，并跑一条注册测试。
howto.when: 当你想让项目支持 WhatsApp（例如说「加一个 WhatsApp 频道」）时接管；它会先问这个号是专用号还是你日常的个人号，确认后才开始安装与认证。

say.text: 帮我加上 WhatsApp 频道，我用的是专用号
say.note: 先问链接方式，再引导扫码或输 8 位配对码

say.text: 用 QR 方式链接 WhatsApp
say.note: 终端显示二维码，约每 20 秒刷新一次

say.text: 我要用平时那个个人号
say.note: 先显示账号风险警告，需你明确确认才继续

howto.what_en: It adds a WhatsApp channel to the project: copies the native Baileys adapter and the whatsapp-formatting skill from the channels branch, registers the adapter, installs pinned packages, builds, and runs a registration test.
howto.when_en: Use when you want the project to support WhatsApp — e.g. you ask to add a WhatsApp channel. It first asks whether you'll use a dedicated or personal number before installing.

say_en.text: Add the WhatsApp channel — I'll use a dedicated number
say_en.note: It asks how to link, then guides QR or pairing code

say_en.text: Link WhatsApp with a QR code
say_en.note: A QR appears in the terminal, refreshing every ~20s

say_en.text: The number I'll use is my everyday personal number
say_en.note: It shows the account-risk warning and asks you to confirm
